title: PAD 01 — PAD VISIBLE, TRUE CENTRE OFF-FRAME
bug: Old path: a centre outside the image forced pad_presence=0, so the pad vanished from the presence target even while its corner was visible.
fix: Pad presence and centre validity are separate. Presence=1 from the visible pad; the centre heat stays empty and pad_ignore covers the visible footprint.
